sections.brief: Documented: Merneptah Stele (c. 1208 BCE, Petrie 1896, people determinative, minority readings); Genesis 32:22-32 and 35:10, Hosea 12:3-4; philology (el + sarah/sarar, yashar; God-as-subject vs Genesis explanation; Day 'El will rule', Smith El-based; Ebla/Ugarit); layers of the name. Figures: compare; time

Documented inner readings: Philo (De Mutatione: 'the man who sees God'; Alesso on ethnos/genos); Origen's threefold sense and 'Israel according to the Spirit' with its replacement-theology risk; Kabbalah: Jacob as Tiferet (Luria via Chabad, Palvanov, Zohar elements); Sacks 'Be Thyself'; John of the Cross and the dark night as a later frame not shown applied to Jacob. Figure: compare

INTERPRETIVE LENS, headed as such: IS (Isis, divine feminine) RA (solar, divine masculine) EL (Most High) laid out fully, with Genesis 32 as template; where it touches Philo/Tiferet/Sacks; Heiser's philological objections (Awset, resh-aleph vs ayin, language families; El conceded); proponents traced: Jordan Maxwell (per Heiser 2008, undated), Glorian glossary (undated); origin untraceable; limits. Figures: flow; compare

Documented mysteries: Eleusis (secret kept), Apuleius Met. XI, Corpus Hermeticum (100-300 CE, Ficino, Casaubon 1614), Iamblichus On the Mysteries; ascent pattern in Plato's Symposium, Plotinus, Merkabah/Hekhalot, Upanishads; resemblance documented, single source not; Egyptian lineage constructions: Rosicrucian manifestos 1614-16, Terrasson's Sethos 1731, Cagliostro 1779, AMORC 1915. Figures: compare; time

Documented literal reading (Mathison, Weber, Scofield notes Gen 12/Deut 30/Rom 11, Hagee 2011, LifeWay 2017, Spector) vs documented inward reading (Philo, Origen, Tiferet, Sacks, PaRDeS link); replacement-theology risk and ICEJ 2012; ARGUMENT labelled: map read as deed; limits (no people usurps a name; within Judaism and Christianity alike); three objections stated fairly. Figure: compare
